Of the 4 approvals this concept needs: 2 insufficient information (zoning and use, alcohol licence), 2 allowed (health permit, building permit and change of use).
rules_conditional_unsupplied.entitlement_path: Health permit to operate; Building permit

open_questions.question: Not known: whether the business is part of a chain that shares its name, look or menu with other locations. Needed for: zoning and use.
open_questions.ask: The applicant: the project description does not say

open_questions.question: Not known: how the liquor licence will be obtained (new, or a transfer from another owner or another location). Needed for: alcohol licence.

headline_findings.sentence: If the business is part of a chain with eleven or more other locations, the concept needs a Conditional Use Authorization, which the Planning Commission decides at a public hearing (Planning Code § 303). What would ask for one: formula retail. Not known: whether the business is part of a chain that shares its name, look or menu with other locations.
headline_findings.condition: the business is part of a chain with eleven or more other locations
missing_inputs: whether the business is part of a chain that shares its name, look or menu with other locations

basis.text: Zoning district NCD-POLK: formula retail is a conditional use (Planning Code § 723, in force since before 2022-01-01).
